title: Ngủ yên
about: Round x19 (album 14), the user: "làm album và chuyển sang sáng tác album mới": sleep music in the style of Sleep in the Dark (ngu-ngon), on a less common progression of its own (template 1), slow (42 bpm), pad, choir, sub, an improvised glass tune, then solo. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece.
